subject: Guest-visible event generated by VirtualBuddy 2.1 / public requestStop
method: Decoded from the captured firmware fixture with the same parser the loader patch implements; tests/test_virtualbuddy_shutdown.py replays it

interrupt.source: GPIO device _CRS ExtendedIRQ (last payload word; this firmware omits the consumer flag byte)

event_pin.source: GPIO device _AEI GpioInt; the pin table immediately precedes the "GPIO" resource source string

event.interpretation: requestStop asserts PL061 pin 6, which raises GIC interrupt 37 and the ACPI _E06 power-button notification

guest_handling.loader: vm/patches/xnu-loader-virtualbuddy-power-button.patch validates the device in the DSDT and publishes blauos,power-button = {base, irq, pin} on the device-tree root
guest_handling.kernel: vm/patches/puredarwin-virtualbuddy-power-button.patch polls PL061 RIS on a bounded 100 ms IOTimerEventSource, acknowledges via GPIOIC, and delivers SIGTERM to PID 1 once (proc_signal)
guest_handling.pid1_route: identical to the accepted guest-triggered route: launchd child cleanup, filesystem unmount, and PSCI SYSTEM_OFF via PDArmPlatformExpert::haltRestart (pdarm-qemu-psci-shutdown.patch)

bounded_failure_behavior.guest: if PID 1 does not reach poweroff the guest keeps running; the power button is not a forced halt
bounded_failure_behavior.host: vm/virtualbuddy_console_probe.swift waits --stop-grace-seconds after requestStop, records orderly-shutdown-timeout, then applies the same operator-confirmed force stop (vm.stop) and records force-stop-recovery with exit code 4
